macros.name: PhiBasePhi
macros.doc: It computes the Bergman φ-representation of x = a + bφ if x turns out to be positive, outputs 0 if both a and b vanish, and outputs a minus sign followed with the expansion of the opposite of x if x < 0.

macros.name: PhiBasePhiSep
macros.doc: The radix separator is customizable as \PhiBasePhiSep. It defaults to a period ..

macros.name: PhiExponents
macros.doc: It outputs the comma separated list of the exponents from the minimal Bergman representation of the absolute value of a + bφ.

macros.name: PhiTypesetX
macros.doc: The default output is math-mode only, as it is of the type a + bφ, with simplifications for zero or negative coefficients.

macros.name: PhiXfromBasePhi
macros.doc: This computes an element from Z[φ] from a Bergman φ-representation.

macros.name: PhiXfromExponents
macros.doc: This computes a φ-integer from an arbitrary list of (comma separated) exponents, not necessarily ordered.

macros.name: ZeckIndices
macros.doc: This computes the Zeck representation as a comma separated list of indices.

macros.name: ZeckNFromIndices
macros.doc: This computes an integer from a list of (comma separated) indices.

macros.name: ZeckNfromWord
macros.doc: This computes a positive integer from a binary word.

macros.name: ZeckTheFSeq
macros.doc: This computes not only one but a whole contiguous series of Fibonacci numbers but its output format is a sequence of braced numbers, and tools such as those of xinttools are needed to manipulate its output.

macros.name: ZeckWord
macros.doc: This computes the Zeck representation as a binary word.
